js: 'Chat voice WP7: spoken turns as the transcript shows them — the mic badge of a dictated turn, a spoken reply with its speaker badge, timing line, delivery cues as chips and its unheard rest greyed behind a not-heard marker; a typed reply keeps its brackets. Needs the thread scripts/chat-voice-seed.py writes into a scratch database (chat-drives.sh does it). Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/chat-voice-render.json --token <owner token> --base <dev instance>'

fetch('/chat/api/threads').then(r => r.json()).then(v => { const t = v.threads.find(t => t.title === 'voice render seed'); if (t) location.href = '/chat?t=' + t.id; return t ? t.id : 'no seeded thread'; })

label: the seeded spoken reply shows its unheard rest

expect: (() => { const a = document.querySelectorAll('.msg-assistant')[0]; const said = getComputedStyle(a.querySelector(':scope > .md p')); const p = a.querySelector('.unheard-text p'); const rest = getComputedStyle(p); const want = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--text-2').trim().replace(/^#(..)(..)(..)$/, (_, r, g, b) => `rgb(${parseInt(r, 16)}, ${parseInt(g, 16)}, ${parseInt(b, 16)})`); return said.color !== rest.color && rest.color === want && rest.fontStyle === 'italic'; })()
label: greyed: the rest is the secondary text colour in italics, the heard part is not

expect: (() => { const lum = c => { const v = c.match(/\d+(\.\d+)?/g).slice(0, 3).map(Number).map(x => x / 255).map(x => x <= 0.03928 ? x / 12.92 : ((x + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4); return 0.2126 * v[0] + 0.7152 * v[1] + 0.0722 * v[2]; }; const fg = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.unheard-text p')).color; const bg = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--bg1').trim().replace(/^#(..)(..)(..)$/, (_, r, g, b) => `rgb(${parseInt(r, 16)}, ${parseInt(g, 16)}, ${parseInt(b, 16)})`); const [a, b] = [lum(fg), lum(bg)].sort((x, y) => y - x); return (a + 0.05) / (b + 0.05) >= 4.5; })()
label: the unheard rest has at least 4.5:1 contrast on the transcript
the heard part is the content, the rest is not in it

expect: (() => { const a = document.querySelectorAll('.msg-assistant')[0]; const chips = [...a.querySelectorAll('.cue-chip')].map(c => c.textContent); return chips.join() === 'laughing,sighs' && !a.textContent.includes('[laughing]') && !a.textContent.includes('[sighs]'); })()
label: its delivery cues are chips, in the heard part and the rest, not raw brackets

expect: (() => { const u = document.querySelector('.msg-unheard .unheard-text').textContent; return u.includes('[a] Teig') && u.includes('[b] Form'); })()
label: a one-letter enumeration ([a], [b]) stays text, not a chip

expect: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.msg-assistant [data-speaker-badge]'); return !!b && b.title.includes('said by audio/supertonic-3-q8-0') && b.title.includes('voice M5') && b.title.includes('not heard'); })()
label: the speaker badge names the voice and says it was interrupted

expect: document.querySelector('.voice-timing summary').textContent.startsWith('ASR 31 ms · first token 208 ms · first audio 782 ms · audio/parakeet-tdt-q8-0 → ')
label: the timing line, collapsed

expect: [...document.querySelectorAll('.voice-timing li')].map(l => l.textContent).includes('loaded during the turn: tts')
label: opens to every stage and the cold starts

expect: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.msg-item-user [data-mic-badge="dictation"]'); return !!b && b.title === 'Dictated · transcribed by audio/parakeet-tdt-q8-0 · 702 ms for 15.8 s of speech'; })()
label: the dictated turn's mic badge, its ASR facts in the tooltip
a typed turn has no badge

expect: (() => { const a = document.querySelectorAll('.msg-assistant')[1]; return a.textContent.includes('typed [laughing] stays text') && !a.querySelector('.cue-chip') && !a.querySelector('[data-speaker-badge]') && !a.querySelector('.msg-unheard'); })()
label: a typed reply keeps its brackets as text
